latestVersion.changelog:
ai-elf-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: Transform portrait images into fantasy elf characters via the WeShop OpenAPI.
- HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai with a required API key (WESHOP_API_KEY).
- Endpoints support image uploading, run initiation, and status polling.
- Security reminders: API key should never be sent outside openapi.weshop.ai.
- Agent configuration allows optional custom elf transformation instructions and batch image generation.
